title: How I Automated My Marketing Workflow With AI
body: I was manually scheduling posts, drafting captions, tracking replies, and building reports every week. The workflow was repetitive and time-consuming, so I built an AI automation pipeline that drafts content, finds engagement opportunities, and queues posts for review.
author: Sarah Chen

title: The Real Problem With Zapier at Scale
body: Zapier helped us start automating, but complex workflows became fragile and expensive. I compared Make.com, n8n, and Activepieces to understand which platform could remove the bottleneck without creating a maintenance burden.
author: Marcus Webb

title: Five Workflow Bottlenecks Killing Marketing Productivity
body: Manual reporting, approval loops, scattered content ideas, and reactive engagement are common bottlenecks. Each one wastes time and makes teams miss high-intent conversations that should have been answered quickly.
author: Priya Nair

title: I Built an AI Lead Generation System That Runs 24/7
body: The system monitors Reddit, LinkedIn, and forums for buying-intent signals. When it finds a relevant question, it drafts a response for human review and updates our CRM automatically.
author: James Okafor

title: Why AI Content Tools Still Feel Disappointing
body: Most AI writing tools produce generic output because they do not understand workflow context, brand voice, or audience nuance. The useful tools are integrated into review workflows and keep humans in the loop.
author: Leila Hashimi

title: A Step-by-Step Guide to Automating LinkedIn Outreach
body: LinkedIn outreach becomes tedious at scale. This guide shows a workflow that enriches leads, drafts personalized openers, schedules follow-ups, and tracks replies without forcing the team to copy-paste between tools.
author: Tom Eriksson

title: HubSpot vs Salesforce for Growing Startups
body: This comparison covers automation capabilities, workflow complexity, integration ecosystems, and the point where startups outgrow simple CRM tools. The biggest issue is often process design rather than features.
author: David Kim

title: How to Build a No-Code AI Workflow From Scratch
body: This tutorial walks through building an AI workflow using Make.com, Airtable, and Claude. It focuses on eliminating manual steps, handling approvals, and keeping the process maintainable for non-technical teams.
author: Fatima Zahra

title: The Marketing Automation Stack That Grew Our SaaS
body: Our stack handles lead capture, nurturing, qualification, content distribution, and reporting. The most valuable workflow alerts sales when a qualified lead visits pricing and provides a context brief automatically.
author: Nina Petrov
